phase.action: For each real comprehension gap, construct the smallest fact-background-inference-why-it-matters bridge, assign exactly one primary placement and exclude adjacent context that cannot change the learning outcome.
inputs: project-context-enrichment packet or equivalent bounded contribution
holdWhen: a bridge lacks observed project evidence or an explicit inference label
external background is used as proof of project behavior
a mandatory prerequisite has no admissible source
placement is chosen only to fill available page space
the source or target revision changes

phase.action: Paginate complete semantic units with an expandable page count, create explicit continuation structures for multi-page units and preserve evidence classes, claim meaning, typography and reading order.
exitEvidence: page count recorded as an outcome rather than a cap
holdWhen: a page target causes content deletion, claim weakening or provenance removal
type size or leading is reduced below the typography contract
a split loses bridge, trace, claim or evidence identity
a mandatory prerequisite is hidden in an appendix
a figure is separated from its interpretive caption
page overflow, clipping, rasterized prose or unexplained content loss exists

validationExtension.requiredComparison: Compare the frozen semantic-unit inventory with the rendered PDF and account for every included, moved, continued, deferred and excluded unit.
requiredEvidence: physical A4 and accessibility review or explicit pending disposition

materialChangeSignals: a hard page maximum is introduced or changed
a prerequisite bridge, worked example, trace, diagram or failure case changes depth
source, manuscript, target PDF or typography revision changes
page size, medium, language, accessibility or printing requirements change
a semantic unit moves between main text and appendix
